annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on general product safety, amending Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 and repealing Council Directive 87/357/EEC and Directive 2001/95/EC
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on general product safety, amending Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 and repealing Council Directive 87/357/EEC and Directive 2001/95/EC
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal for a General Product Safety Regulation replacing the 2001 GPSD. It sets a safety net for non-harmonised consumer products, covering new technology risks such as connectivity, software updates, cybersecurity and AI-powered products, with obligations for online marketplaces, traceability, recalls, and the Safety Gate alert system.
key_provisions_or_claims: General safety requirement for consumer products, with presumption of safety via European standards
Safety assessment must account for connectivity, software updates, cybersecurity and evolving AI-powered functionality
Specific obligations for online marketplaces and a responsible EU economic operator for all products
Strengthened traceability, recall notices and consumer remedies
RAPEX renamed Safety Gate, with Commission arbitration and penalty guidelines
